ImageDescription.value:
Photo - Einödhof Hinterkaifeck - before 1922.
  • Depiction of the Hinterkaifeck wasteland, labelled Hint.-Kaifeck in the (official topographic) position sheet 1:25,000, sheet number 552, year of publication 1912 on BayernAtlas. The depiction of individual buildings including the place name Hint.-Kaifeck was retained in the (partially) continued editions of sheet no. 552 from 1940 and 1953. It was not until 1959, the year in which the 1:25,000 Schrobenhausen 7433 topographic map was published, that the Bavarian State Surveying Office changed the cartographic designation. Landesvermessungsamt added the cartographic symbol "Gedenkkreuz, Wegkreuz, Bildstock (Marterl)" at the site of the farm building demolished around 1923. This representation remained on the above map until the year of publication 2007, see official topographic map 1:25,000 Schrobenhausen 7433, year of publication 1995, valid until 2006. In the current map editions, a memorial cross (Marterl) is entered, which was erected approx. 260 metres further southwest on a local road leading off to the east and south, this road leads directly to the Kaifeck wasteland in the municipality of Waidhofen. Translated with DeepL.com (free version).
  • Note: German: Gedenkkreuz, Wegkreuz, Bildstock (bayerisch: Marterl) => English: Memorial cross, wayside cross, wayside shrine (Bavarian: Marterl).
